title: Xanthe and the Letter
author: August Sandoval
blurb: Noor Eriksen, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, has spent twelve years learning which silences keep people safe. But when the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
